combinations.readout: mechanical allodynia and cold hyperalgesia (PWT, cold withdrawal latency)
combinations.magnitude: FOXA2-mediated analgesia substantially reversed by CPT1A knockdown
combinations.evidence_quote: Notably, this FOXA2-mediated analgesic effect was substantially reversed when co-expressed with AAV-Cpt1a−, suggesting CPT1A’s potential role in modulating FOXA2’s antinociceptive function.

combinations.readout: lipid droplet accumulation in spinal dorsal horn
combinations.magnitude: CPT1A ablation partially reversed FOXA2 regulation of lipid homeostasis; increased LDs vs Foxa2+ alone
combinations.evidence_quote: Compared to the SNI + AAV-Foxa2⁺ group, the AAV-Foxa2⁺/Cpt1a⁻ group exhibited increased lipid droplet accumulation in the SDH(Fig. 7G), along with elevated Bodipy fluorescence intensity (Fig. 7H).

combinations.readout: lipid droplet degradation in primary microglia
combinations.evidence_quote: Consistent with our in vivo findings, primary microglial experiments revealed that siRNA-mediated CPT1A knockdown (siCpt1a) abolished oeFoxa2-induced LDs degradation (Fig. 7J, Fig. S2C)

combinations.magnitude: oeFoxa2 activated reporter over 20-fold; oeHdac3 co-expression abolished it
combinations.evidence_quote: while oeHdac3 co-expression abolished this transactivation effect.

combinations.readout: lipid droplet accumulation and ROS in primary microglia
combinations.magnitude: forskolin alleviated siFoxa2-induced LD accumulation and ROS
combinations.evidence_quote: Forskolin, a known inducer of lipid droplet degradation, can alleviate the lipid droplet accumulation caused by siFoxa2 and reduce ROS production.
